step1.title: What do you track?
step1.description: Each day, mark your mood, stress, energy, focus, and whether you exercised. It takes under a minute — and becomes the foundation of your personal insights.

step2.title: How often?
step2.description: Once a day, whenever suits you. Morning, afternoon, or evening — what matters is doing it consistently. Missed a day? No worries, just keep going.

step3.title: What will you get?
step3.description: Fewer than 3 check-ins this week → a basic overview. 3 or more → a personal AI analysis: mood patterns, stress detection, and a tailored recommendation just for you.

step4.title: Trends & progress
step4.description: From the second week, the app compares: better or worse than last week? The longer you keep your journal, the more accurate and useful your insights become.
